summary: Frontend-only regression completed on the public URL. Root load, all five tabs, notification SW-failure fallback, full finance workflow, mount automations/idempotency, edit-dialog hydration, duplicate-name charts, and production build all passed.
seed_data_creation: Used isolated finance_tracker_data_v1 UI-created data and fixtures for two categories (including duplicate names), current/closed-month income and expenses, a frequent expense, recurring income, goal, notifications, and auto-save. No backend/shared data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified https://monthly-budget-313.preview.emergentagent.com. All five tabs navigated. With Notification.permission mocked granted, enabling alerts and spending 85/100 triggered exactly one SW showNotification attempt; forced SW rejection produced exactly one fallback Notification and persisted the 80% marker, with no runtime error. Public preview emitted no guarded warning; the optimized build compiled successfully and its minified guard resolves false before console.warn. UI flow created two categories, FAB income/expense, frequent expense and application, recurring income, goal, closed-month transactions, and auto-save. Seeded mount test showed both recurring and auto-save toasts, added one recurring income and RD$400 to the goal, rendered KPIs (RD$1,200 income/RD$95 expense), Monthly Comparison, and Auto-save History; second reload produced no duplicate data/toasts. CategoryDialog and GoalDialog hydrated and rehydrated edited values. Duplicate category names rendered two pie sectors with no React key warning. One transient 404 console event occurred in an intermediate diagnostic run but could not be reproduced; final network diagnostics had no failed responses or console errors.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defect reproduced. The intended change is present: all warning sites call logWarn, and the optimized production bundle compiles the environment guard to false while preserving SW rejection fallback behavior. Intermediate automation failures were test-only selector/toast timing assumptions and were corrected before final passing runs.
